messages:
ellie.chen: Hey @people-ops — my March paycheck shows CAD taxes taken (T4 payroll) and also US federal/state withheld in USD. Net pay -$127.22. I moved from Toronto -> San Francisco on 2026-03-05 and updated my address in Workday on 2026-03-04. Can someone check?

tanya-hr: Thanks Ellie — tagging @jamal-payroll and @marta-taxops. Can you attach the paystub (redact acct last4) and your passport entry date? Also did you change bank details before or after the run?

ellie.chen: attaching paystub (redacted). I updated bank to US on 2026-03-06 but the March run seems to have used my CAD account. Passport entry: 2026-03-05. Also had a stock refresh payment on 2026-03-10 — that shows up with US withholding, but the base salary run on 2026-03-15 shows CAD taxes too.

jamal-payroll: I can see two payroll runs that posted overlapping earnings for the same pay period: CAN-PR-2026-03-15 (CAD) and US-PR-2026-03-10 (USD). Looks like an overlapping termination/rehire created two active employment records and both payrolls picked up pro-rated salary.

marta-taxops: If we reverse the CAN run we need documented EoR dates and the transfer email to avoid duplicate CRA reporting. Ellie — which employer of record issued which earnings? Who processed the RSU withholding (redwood-can or redwood-us)?

ellie.chen: EORe: redwood-can through 2026-03-04; redwood-us from 2026-03-05 onward. The RSU tax withholding was processed by redwood-us on 2026-03-10, but the CAN payroll still ran on 2026-03-15. I can drop the transfer email in this thread.

jamal-payroll: Action plan:
1) Reverse the CAN payroll (txn: CAN-REV-4512) — this will debit the CAN ledger & restore gross/taxes in our books.
2) Issue a manual refund for the CAD net over-withheld; you said bank is now USD, so we'll convert and refund in USD unless you ask otherwise.
3) Coordinate with taxops to file a T4 amendment (and T4A if needed) and flag the W-2 team so the US reporting is correct.
ETA: reversal scheduled for tomorrow EOD, refund within 5 business days after reversal posts.

ellie.chen: :thumbsup: Please refund to my USD bank (I closed the CAD acct).

jamal-payroll: Noted — refund to USD. Finance will use FX rate on reversal posting date (2026-03-16) unless you request original CAD. Refund txn id will be REF-USD-9812 and I'll paste it here when posted.

marta-taxops: We'll also check the RSU withholding. Because your residence changed on 2026-03-05, US tax treatment likely applies to the RSU, but we'll confirm. If CRA received reporting we'll request an amendment.

liam-eng: Adding a note from ENG: we triggered the rehire from the HRIS transfer and it looks like the platform allowed overlapping active statuses. Can HR/Payroll confirm fix in the rehire flow so this doesn't repeat?

tanya-hr: We'll patch the rehire flow today to block overlapping active records. @jamal-payroll please add rollback steps and the reversal checklist to the payroll runbook.

payroll-bot: Auto-recon job finished. Duplicate-run flag set: DUP-1748902468. Reversal scheduled: 2026-03-17T18:00Z.

jamal-payroll: Thanks team — I'll post the reversal confirmation and refund txn once complete. Ellie, ping me if anything else shows up on comp statements.

ellie.chen: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help.
